# BioAgents package regression oracles

Transferred from `tests/workflow_export/domain_cases` at the T14 migration snapshot.
These 73 domain-specific assertions execute only inside the imported package runtime
container. They are fixtures for portability tests, never generic planner defaults
or API imports. Source attribution remains in BioAgents migration evidence.
